name: renters-in-recovery
description: Renters in Recovery: tenant rights for Illinois sober living residents

scripts.build: npm run cleanup && npx parcel build --public-url ./ && cp -r public/. dist/
scripts.push-gh: npm run build && gh-pages --dist dist --branch gh-pages --cname www.illinoisrentersinrecovery.org --message "Deploy $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

author: Jason Sherrick
